targets.text: A Strands Decider 2B distilled from Clef 27B knows how to operate a Jetson Orin, and a quantized, healed build under 1 GB runs fast and accurately on a Jetson Orin Nano as a lobes decider domain
the bundle that runs on the Nano is the same sha256-pinned artifact measured in final; nothing is rebuilt on the board
the operator and agents that run Jetson boxes (nvsh-style shells, lobes peers) asking typed decisions — choice / noul / score over /v1/systemone — about operating a Jetson Orin
every Jetson-ops record is a /v1/systemone body (choice, noul or score) that an nvsh shell or lobes peer could send; no tool-calling or free-text records

the stock strands-decider-2B-qwen3.5-v1-2610 scores top-1 0.756 on the Clef probe set (Clef W4A16 0.9354; incident 0.655), knows nothing Jetson-specific, runs bf16 only (~3.8 GB of loaded weights: 1.88B params incl. a 508.6M-param 248,320x2048 embedding), and there is no Orin Nano card in lobes
stock 2610's numbers are re-measured by jev-factory's benchmark stage on the probe set and the Jetson-ops sides, not copied from the lobes scope

an Orin Nano (8 GB unified, shared with the OS and the workload) cannot host Clef 27B or a bf16 2B beside real work; a <1 GB specialist puts a calibrated Jetson-ops decider on the smallest board, local and offline
the quantized student's resident memory on the board is measured and reported next to the board's free memory under workload (c19)

a distilled Jetson-ops 2B, LoRA merged, quantized and healed to under 1 GB on disk, ships as a private bundle (weights, calibration.json, gate.json and a documented loader contract) that runs on a Jetson Orin Nano through jev-factory's own /v1/systemone serve wrapper and agrees with its bf16 student and with Clef on the held-out human-gold Jetson-ops test set; hosting it as a lobes decider domain is lobes' separate plan
final measures the served bundle on the AGX Orin, and on the Nano once reachable, through jev-factory's serve wrapper, not the bf16 checkpoint

distillation reuses jev-factory's distillery (jev distill: preregister .. upload), retargeted from hobson-v21 to strands-decider-2B-qwen3.5-v1-2610 @216d1ccb: pins.py DECIDER_REPO + adapter/head sha256, prereg.py lora_r 48 / lora_alpha 96 / lora_targets incl. in_proj_qkv,in_proj_z,in_proj_a,in_proj_b,out_proj, the stock_v21 reference row
after retargeting no v21 pin, digest or reference row remains in pins.py or prereg.py, and the 2610 adapter and head sha256 match the snapshot at 216d1ccb

a new Jetson-ops domain dataset of typed-decision records ({id,state,questions,gold,split,source,licence,gold_provenance}, licence apache-2.0, mit or cc-by-4.0 with attribution) built from the operator's measured Orin evidence in lobes-cli docs/evidence, jetson-containers-nv (l4t_version.py, setup/swap/ram scripts, package compatibility), jetson-ai-lab tutorials, NVIDIA-AI-IOT jetson-device-skills and jetson-bsp-skills at pinned commits and nvsh device-CLI verbs; Clef labels the train side

every record carries source, licence and gold_provenance; a source outside the licence allowlist is refused at the dataset stage; test records come from text disjoint from train and the contamination check fails closed

the headline eval is a held-out Jetson-ops test set with HUMAN gold (jev-factory counts only human-gold records toward its bars), scored for accuracy, agreement with Clef, ECE and confident-wrong rate, plus the existing Clef probe set to measure loss of general ability
the headline table counts only operator-approved human-gold records on the test side, measured once in final; the Clef probe-set score is reported and gates nothing

quantize after distilling: merge the LoRA, drop the unused vision tower (331.4M) and MTP head (60.8M), quantize the 24 text blocks to 4-bit, and quantize the full-vocabulary 248,320x2048 embedding (508.6M params, 1.0 GB in bf16) to INT4 or INT8 so the weight files total < 10^9 bytes; keep the fp32 pointer head (12.6 MB) and small DeltaNet params (in_proj_a/b, conv1d, A_log, dt_bias, norms) unquantized
on-disk weight size is computed from the bundle's files and is < 1 GB; a pruned vocabulary is recorded with its kept id list, and a prompt token outside it fails closed
the weight files' byte sum is < 10^9 and the tokenizer is the unmodified 2610 tokenizer (no id is unreachable)

heal the quantized model: a short distillation pass that trains the quantized student (or its LoRA/norms) against the bf16 distilled student's and Clef's soft labels, and the healed build must reach agreement >= 0.97 with the bf16 student on the Jetson-ops fit/selection folds before it can ship
heal runs at most once; the >= 0.97 agreement is measured on the fit and selection folds only, never on test or held-out

lobes' orin-nano machine card, shape and quantized decider backend are a separate lobes plan, not jev-factory tasks; jev-factory fixes and documents the bundle format (file layout, quantization scheme, loader entry point) that plan consumes
no jev-factory task edits lobes-cli; the bundle-format doc is the hand-off

teacher-label reaches the Orin gateway through an SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1, so SystemOneClient's localhost-only guard (require_localhost) stays, and the client gains the gateway bearer key (env-var name only) and the X-Lobes-Model: decider:general header, which today it does not send
no non-localhost URL is ever configured; the bearer key is passed by env-var name and is never printed or written to a manifest
Clef 27B stays served only on the AGX Orin (W4A16); this work changes no other box's served model or shape, and the existing decider:strands-general on spark2 stays as the stock baseline

the only model jev-factory starts on the AGX Orin is the <1 GB quant for measurement, under the recorded memory cap and never during teacher labelling; Clef's lane and every other box's served model are untouched

on the held-out human-gold Jetson-ops test set both the distilled bf16 student and the shipped healed quant beat the stock 2610 by >= 10 points top-1 and are within 5 points of Clef W4A16; the healed quant is < 1 GB of weights on disk and agrees >= 0.97 with the bf16 student; median and p95 latency on the AGX Orin and the Nano are measured and reported
every threshold is written into the pre-registration before the first train command and is measured on the shipped quantized artifact as well as the bf16 student
nvsh's /v1/systemone provider for evals/tool_jev is nvsh's work, not jev-factory's; the comparison with nvsh's Tool-Jev 0.8B Q4_K_M scorer is reported once that provider exists, never gated
no jev-factory task edits nvsh

the contamination check is retargeted to 2610: data/upstream_sources.json is regenerated from the 2610 model card at 216d1ccb (48 datasets, incl. tasksource/tasksource-jev-typed-decisions and tasksource/procedural-typed-decisions), so typed-decisions general-guard records are marked overlapping, not clean
the regenerated manifest lists exactly the 2610 card's datasets at 216d1ccb, and a typed-decisions record is reported overlapping

before training, stock 2610 is served on the inferred base revision b1485b2 (provenance.json: 'inferred: Hub main at training time; hosts did not pin it') and must reproduce its own published JevBench w4096 result (eval/summary.json, 0.7792 = 180/231) within its CI; a miss stops the run as a base-mismatch
the reproduction uses the same served path and w4096 window as the card, and its result is recorded in the benchmark manifest with n and CI

a record counts as human gold only with an operator approval record (record sha256, decision, timestamp) written by a jev review gold-approval path; agent-drafted test records are stored as proposed and the final stage refuses a test record without a matching approval (records.py gold_provenance is a free string today)
a test record whose sha256 has no approval entry is refused by final with its id printed; editing an approved record voids its approval
every Jetson-ops question offers at most 24 options (strands_decider_config.json num_slots = 24) and fits max_length 4096; the dataset stage refuses, never truncates, a record that exceeds either
the dataset manifest counts refusals by reason (over_slots, over_length) and no record is truncated

the dataset bundle never contains the Clef probe set (private) and passes scripts/scan-secrets.py plus a hostname/IP and side-model-name scan before upload; evidence-derived records are redacted at draft time
the upload stage refuses when any scan finds a hit, printing file and line only

tasks.summary: Jetson runtime spike: prove the 2610 decider's torch path and a 4-bit kernel on JetPack 6.2 (sm_87)
acceptance_criteria: docs/evidence/2026-10-jetson-runtime-spike.md records, for the Nano (and the AGX Orin if run there): /etc/nv_tegra_release, CUDA, torch/transformers/torchao versions, MemAvailable, whether Qwen3.5-2B's Gated DeltaNet torch fallback runs one forward pass, and whether an int4 and an int8 weight-only linear runs on sm_87, each with the exact command and output
the doc ends with a recorded verdict per format (int4 torchao, int8 torchao, other) — works / fails with error text — and nothing in jev_factory/ changes
tasks.instruction: Operator-attended; outward actions on boards. Nano first (ssh nano; it was unreachable 2026-10-15, operator says it is coming online). On the AGX Orin run nothing without the operator's go, under a cgroup cap (systemd-run --user -p MemoryMax=4G), never while teacher labelling runs, and never touch Clef's lane. Work in a scratch venv on the board; no repo edits except the evidence doc. Never name side/experiment models in the doc. Resolves plan risk on the Jetson runtime (frame park v1).

tasks.summary: jev review --serve: a gold page over the t8 ledger
acceptance_criteria: jev review --gold FILE --serve serves a local page listing test records with proposed gold; approve, edit (per question label) and reject write the same append-only ledger entries as the CLI path, through jev_factory.review.gold; --serve binds 127.0.0.1 only
tests drive the page's endpoints (no browser): an approve then edit voids the approval exactly as the CLI path does; a corrupted ledger renders an error and writes nothing
tasks.instruction: Own jev_factory/review/server.py, jev_factory/cli/_commands/review.py (only the --gold --serve refusal) and tests/test_review_gold_server.py. Mirror the corrections page (CorrectionsApp) in server.py; reuse review.gold for every read and write.

tasks.summary: jev review --drafts: a local draft-review page with evidence
acceptance_criteria: jev review --drafts FILE [--evidence FILE] --serve serves on 127.0.0.1 a one-record-at-a-time page over drafted records of every split, showing state, questions, options, drafted gold, the evidence quote and why, source group and split; filters by split, source and review status; keyboard shortcuts

keep / drop / edit-gold / note decisions append to an append-only draft-review ledger keyed by record id and sha256 (dry-run by default for the CLI path, --apply writes); a library function applies the ledger to produce the reviewed draft file (dropped removed, edits applied, notes kept out of records); an edited test record's later gold approval still goes through the t8 gold ledger
tests drive the endpoints (no browser) for every decision kind, a corrupted ledger renders an error and writes nothing, and teken cli doctor --strict passes
tasks.instruction: Own jev_factory/review/drafts.py (new), jev_factory/review/drafts_page.html (new), jev_factory/review/server.py (add a DraftsApp beside GoldApp), jev_factory/cli/_commands/review.py (the --drafts flag), the review catalog entry and tests/test_review_drafts.py. Mirror GoldApp and the gold page (t24) for style, token and Host checks; reuse jev_factory.review.gold for record hashing.

risks.text: Jetson runtime unknown (frame park v1): torch + transformers 5.x for Qwen3.5 Gated DeltaNet and a 4-bit linear kernel on sm_87 under JetPack 6.2 (CUDA 12.6) may not exist; t1 settles it before t10 picks a kernel; if neither int4 nor int8 runs, the Nano target needs a recorded deviation
risks.resolution: t1 spike on the Nano (docs/evidence/2026-10-jetson-runtime-spike.md): torch 2.11/CUDA 12.6 sees sm_87; Qwen3.5-2B torso runs on the DeltaNet torch fallback (~440 ms bf16, 512 tokens); torchao int8 and int4 weight-only both run (int4 ~1.9 s, cosine 0.935 pre-heal)

risks.text: pre-lock knob decisions from #18 still open (frame park v2: grid and selection semantics, split fractions, audit thresholds, KD temperature, init_mode, kl_frozen_weight 0.3 used by 2610, confident_wrong 0.9, gate coverage 0.8, scalar temperature): the operator decides them before preregister --apply

size budget is tight: INT4 blocks ~0.77 GB plus an INT4 embedding ~0.27-0.29 GB estimates 1.0-1.06 GB against < 10^9 bytes; an INT8 embedding does not fit, so the build may need INT4 embedding with grouped scales or lower-bit blocks — a miss is recorded unavailable, and changing the route is a deviation
the Nano may stay unreachable; the AGX Orin edge numbers then stand alone and the Nano rows are reported as not measured
teacher labelling throughput: one sequential request at a time over a tunnel to the Orin gateway; train-pool size is bounded by labelling time and must not starve Clef's production lane
torchao int4 failed on CPU in #18 ('Requires mslk >= 1.0.0') and was never run on a GPU (lapse l14); the build may have to run on the AGX Orin or the Nano itself
lobes' Nano card, shape and quantized backend are a separate lobes plan consuming docs/distill-bundle-format.md
nvsh's /v1/systemone provider for evals/tool_jev and the Tool-Jev comparison

serve peak memory on the Nano: the quantized serve path builds the full bf16 skeleton (~3.8 GB) before swapping in the quantized state; on an 8 GB Nano (6.6 GiB available) the peak may hit the cgroup cap — measure in t1/t15, and load on the meta device if it does

quant.choose_format still falls back to bf16 when no quant qualifies; bf16 is over the < 10^9-byte budget (c36), so for this run a no-qualifying-quant outcome must be recorded as a failed bar, not a bf16 ship — operator decision before t23

edge agreement (t15) compares against the final's student predictions, but final scores only test and held-out while edge may only use the selection fold and probe set, so the overlap is empty; t17 must point edge at the quant stage's selection-fold predictions of the shipped format (same sha256 bundle) instead

the 231 JevBench w4096 task texts are not shipped with the 2610 card; the stock reproduction needs them converted to Record jsonl (source: JevBench public items at commit 1bcc55e per 2610's sources.md); until stage_benchmark writes stock_reproduction.json, train's base-match guard has nothing to read — t17 must make an absent record refuse for this run

torchao 0.13 int4 weight-only runs on the Nano but ~4x slower than bf16 (~1.9 s vs ~440 ms per 512-token forward), likely a generic fallback kernel on sm_87; latency is reported not gated (c26) but 'runs fast' (c1) is at risk — evaluate other int4 kernels/layouts before t23 measures latency

the pruned-vocabulary comparison's OOV refusal rate must be measured on the probe set (disjoint from the kept-id prompts), or the comparison (c38) is uninformative; t17 wires the probe set into compare_pruned
heal mix weights (bf16_student 0.5 / clef 0.5) and KL-only heal loss are agent placeholders; the operator decides them with the other pre-lock knobs (park v2) before preregister --apply
